blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-privacy-1 (E-mail address and display name written to the application log) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-privacy-2 (E-mail address sent to the Beacon analytics SaaS to count sign-ups) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: log.info("new signup email=%s name=%s id=%s", email, display_name, user_id)
findings.recommendation: Log only the opaque user id (`log.info("new signup id=%s", user_id)`). Every sign-up currently copies the member's e-mail address and display name into the INFO log, and from there into every log sink, rotation and backup, outside the retention and erasure that apply to the users table (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation, 5(1)(e) storage limitation, Art. 17 erasure). Add a test asserting the log record does not contain the e-mail.
findings.title: E-mail address and display name written to the application log

findings.recommendation: Drop `email` from the event properties: the stated purpose ("Sign-ups are counted in product analytics") needs no e-mail address, and the user id already identifies the event. As written, every sign-up ships the member's e-mail to a third-party processor (beacon.example.com) where account erasure will not reach it (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation, Art. 17, Art. 28). Prefer a pseudonymous id over the raw database id if Beacon must not link events to members. Add a test asserting the tracked properties carry no e-mail.
findings.title: E-mail address sent to the Beacon analytics SaaS to count sign-ups

findings.evidence: """Product analytics, sent to the Beacon SaaS (beacon.example.com)."""
findings.recommendation: Question for the team: the proposal's Impact and Domains do not name Beacon as a new processor, nor whether it hosts data outside the EEA. Record the processor, its data processing agreement (GDPR Art. 28), its hosting region (Chapter V) and an entry in the records of processing (Art. 30) before events with personal data flow to it.
findings.title: New processor Beacon not identified in the plan, transfer location unknown

findings.evidence: - [x] personal-data — collects e-mail addresses and display names
findings.recommendation: Question for the team: the change starts collecting e-mail addresses and display names through self sign-up but states neither the lawful basis (GDPR Art. 6), nor how long the `users` rows are kept, nor how a member's erasure or access request reaches them, backups included (Art. 5(1)(e), Art. 15–17). Only the controller can decide; state it in the proposal.
findings.title: Purpose, lawful basis and retention of the sign-up data are not stated
